mapper.insert: INSERT INTO physical_cluster (id, name, description, kubeconfig_base64_encrypted, status, gpu_types, location, node_labels, taints, max_cpu_cores, max_memory_gib, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{kubeconfigBase64Encrypted}, #{status}, #{gpuTypes}, #{location}, #{nodeLabels}, #{taints}, #{maxCpuCores}, #{maxMemoryGib}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE physical_cluster SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, kubeconfig_base64_encrypted = #{kubeconfigBase64Encrypted}, status = #{status}, gpu_types = #{gpuTypes}, location = #{location}, node_labels = #{nodeLabels}, taints = #{taints}, max_cpu_cores = #{maxCpuCores}, max_memory_gib = #{maxMemoryGib}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE physical_cluster SET gpu_types = #{gpuTypes}, hami_splits = #{hamiSplits}, max_cpu_cores = #{maxCpuCores}, max_memory_gib = #{maxMemoryGib}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM physical_cluster ORDER BY created_at DESC
